notes.title: Sensorium Galaxy v0.4.118.10863 Update
notes.content:
[h2]New Additions[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]New Multiplayer Location Added - "Starship"[/b]
This location offers novel musical and dance experiences that can be shared with other users. Dive into the world of electronic music orchestrated by a drone DJ performing generative AI music, observe the stylized dancers enriching the atmosphere, and flaunt your own dance moves amidst Virtual Beings or fellow users.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/b14f2ca6d620ea67ffa1904316121a2216aaddb5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/917ecde6e5c83d65485973ea313fdd33574e0d6c.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Introducing the New "Cozy Shuttle" Location[/b]
This new Shuttle provides users with the captivating streams displayed on-screen, and a proper atmosphere to partake in intriguing conversations between AI-controlled virtual entities. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/a8531efe46eeb22dedc2cad76c8fc23952f4cedc.png[/img]
[*] [b]A New World Selection Device Unveiled at the Starship Location[/b]
This feature offers users a seamless and intuitive way to navigate between various VR worlds. The world selector logic has been revamped for smoother transitions, with further enhancements scheduled in subsequent updates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/d240412592a00eac393ae8c36ee026ac0a0bf3ff.png[/img]
[*] [b]Multilayered Metaverse: Individual portals have been incorporated across different locations, guiding you on a curated journey through diverse experiences.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/2c920fa810fb63e9ecd9e6f5bf39b43b8431a3e7.png[/img]
[*] [b]Enhanced Shuttle Location with a Dedicated Video Screen[/b]
Delve into the Sensorium metaverse video experiences directly within your virtual reality space, engaging with live streams and captivating videos.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements and Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Enhanced Shuttle Location with a Dedicated Video Screen[/b]
Delve into the Sensorium metaverse video experiences directly within your virtual reality space, engaging with live streams and captivating videos.
[*] [b]The traditional world selection menu in the "Shuttle" location has been replaced with a teleport function that seamlessly transports the user to the new "Starship" location.[/b]
[*] [b]Virtual Beings are now more interactive! Upon your arrival at a location, your virtual companions will take notice and greet you.[/b]
[*] [b]Enhancements to "Salvador Dali Experience" Location.[/b]
Upgraded lighting, finessed environments, and asteroid rotation adjustments amplify the immersion effect.
[*] [b]Introducing a New Virtual Being - Vinxa at the "Shuttle" Location.[/b]
Vinxa, a new interactive character, can engage users in diverse topic conversations.
[*] [b]Refinements to "Audio Board" Mechanics in the "Shuttle" Location.[/b]
The Audio Board's functionality and visual effects have been optimized, particularly when users attach planets to it.
[*] [b]Lighting Design Upgrade in the Asteroid Belt Location Leveraging Lumen Technology.[/b]
Lumen technology facilitates dynamic indirect lighting that considers geometry, materials, and light settings. Minor aesthetic and lighting palette adjustments, new lighting scenarios, and character lighting modifications have been implemented.
[*] [b]Updated Avatar Customization System.[/b]
Expanded avatar options for user selection. Expect additional enhancements in future updates.
[*] [b]Upgraded Multiplayer Infrastructure for Enhanced Stability.[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Corrected an issue causing Virtual Beings to be misaligned by planets from the "Audio Board".[/b]
[*] [b]Resolved a bug that prevented the VR user's name from appearing on the multiplayer map.[/b]
[*] [b]Enhanced avatar textures, lighting, and clothing color schemes.[/b]
[*] [b]Resolved an issue causing brief user appearances outside the "Shuttle" location when entering the product or teleporting from another map.[/b]
[*] [b]Corrected a problem affecting the planet rotation speed on the "Audio Board" in the "Shuttle" location.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed an issue that caused the Virtual Being to continually gaze at the user when approached.[/b]
[*] [b]Rectified improper rotation of Virtual Beings.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed the endless rotation of Virtual Beings following greetings and conversations.[/b]
[*] [b]Implemented minor tweaks to sound effects when interacting with ACS.[/b]
[*] [b]Numerous other bug fixes and optimizations were carried out.[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Sensorium Galaxy v0.4.24.9168 Update
notes.content:
[h2]New Additions[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]"Asteroid Belt" and "PRISM" locations now feature enhanced visual effects around the DJ Booth and Outer ring.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/dbe039415034634a029f7b96afa4fc27e0ad215f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/9a3eeb8fcc56a46b22c3374d8fb2a3d28c32ac72.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]"Shuttle" location now includes pairs of Virtual Beings with cross-context communication support, enabling AI characters to engage in deep contextual dialogues.[/b] Users can observe, eavesdrop on, or initiate conversations with any AI characters.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements and Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]The "Salvador Dali Experience" location has been visually enhanced, with improved effects and a more stylized floor design.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/c8cdf82bc2e00648c30203e9456c9c26f6fbc385.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]The "Audio Board" mechanic in the "Shuttle" location has been upgraded with a new design.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/a422d29ea4b1fbe7902031d8b96a2f7b469315b6.gif[/img]
[*] [b]The "Shuttle" location's World Selection Menu has been temporarily replaced for easier use while awaiting the final design.[/b] Simply touch the green square to teleport to the chosen world.
[*] [b]Lighting in the "Asteroid Belt" location has been improved using Lumen technology for fully dynamic indirect lighting.[/b]
[*] [b]User movement speed and inertia in the VR environment have been adjusted for Valve Index, Oculus, and HTC Vive controllers.[/b]
[*] [b]The control system has been updated to the new Enhanced Input system.[/b]
[*] [b]Improvements have been made to the VR IK system, primarily focusing on character leg positioning and behavior.[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Resolved facial animation issues with user avatars.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed image blurring in VR.[/b]
[*] [b]Addressed turn issues with the HTC Vive Trackpad.[/b]
[*] [b]Solved user teleportation problems in VR when using HTC Vive equipment.[/b]
[*] [b]Corrected non-returning teleport spheres in VR.[/b]
[*] [b]Eliminated freezing when returning from the "PRISM" to the "Shuttle" location.[/b]
[*] [b]Adjusted character positions in the Avatar Gallery within the ACS room.[/b]
[*] [b]Balanced voice levels for virtual characters in the "Shuttle" location.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed overall volume levels in the "Shuttle" location.[/b]
[/list]
